info.title: POS / POS Referral Onboarding API
info.description: Backend for the digital onboarding flow (link generation, form, documents, approvals). Login/auth is provided by an existing system and is not part of this service.

post.description:
Called by the SM (Sales Manager) app after the SM logs in and enters
the POS / Referral name + mobile number. Creates the onboarding
record and returns a token + shareable URL - nothing is rendered by
this backend; the URL points at a route the frontend team owns.

get.description:
The frontend's onboarding page calls this on load (using the :token
from its own route) to validate the link and get the prefill data
(name, number, user_type, current status) needed to render the
correct form/step. This is how the shared link "renders" on the
frontend - the backend never serves HTML, it only backs the route.

put.description:
Edits ONLY terms_and_conditions, independent of the general form-save
endpoint. terms_and_conditions is set to a fixed value at record
creation - this is the sole way to change it afterward.

post.description:
Final "Review & Submit" step. Runs basic form/document validation and
a duplicate check, then moves the record into the approval workflow
(UNDER_REVIEW), matching the "System Processing" stage in the flow.

schema.title: Response List Onboarding Api V1 Admin Onboarding Get

post.description:
Manually promotes an active POS Referral to a full POS. Feeds the
Ageing Report: joining_date (set on approval) and pos_conversion_date
(set here) together give the "how long were they a referral" duration.

schema.title: Response List Users Data Api V1 Admin Users Data Get
Response List Document Details Api V1 Admin Document Details Get

get.description:
Date of Joining -> POS Referral -> POS Conversion Date.

Includes every record that either currently is a POS Referral
(pending conversion) or was converted from one (pos_conversion_date
is set) - a plain POS that was never a referral has neither and is
excluded.

schema.title: Response Ageing Report Api V1 Admin Reports Ageing Get

AgeingReportItem.title: AgeingReportItem
AgeingReportItem.description:
One row of the Ageing Report: how long a POS Referral has been (or
was) a referral before converting to a POS.

conversion_status:
  - "CONVERTED": already promoted to POS - ageing_days is final.
  - "PENDING": still an active POS Referral - ageing_days counts up
    to today, and within_90_days tells you if the 90-day target has
    already been missed.

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description: Which users_data file column an uploaded file is stored against.

OnboardingFormUpdate.title: OnboardingFormUpdate
OnboardingFormUpdate.description:
Partial/upsert payload for the fields users_data actually has.
terms_and_conditions is NOT editable here - it's a fixed value set at
creation, editable only via PUT .../terms-and-conditions.
